purpose: Default requirements document format used when no project-specific format exists: frontmatter for additive features, requirement ID catalog, body template, error case rules, and severity catalog.
summary: Frontmatter required for additive (temporary-feature) requirement documents
Requirement ID prefix catalog such as FNC, NFR, SEC, ERR and GLS
Body template: title, glossary line, overview, preconditions, requirement list, error cases, open items
Error case table with classification and recovery or reporting
Guidance on writing error cases following the error classification spec
Severity catalog for the additive feature frontmatter violation
title: 要件定義書 デフォルトフォーマット
